     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Address all actionable items identified in the sprint synthesis report for `2026-05-19-orchestrator-gui-polish` — six items spanning test coverage gaps, type-safety improvements, minor code hygiene, a comment fix, a validator tightening, and a `renderQueueTable` refactor to reduce accumulated complexity.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Refactor `renderQueueTable` (~130 lines) by extracting three named helper functions — `_buildQueueHtml`, `_bindQueueActions`, `_mountLogPreviews` — reducing `renderQueueTable` to a ~20-line coordinating shell. This improves readability and makes individual steps unit-testable in future.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/gui/public/views/orchestrator.js` — `renderQueueTable` function and surrounding module scope
    14	
    15	## Deliverables
    16	
    17	- New function `_buildQueueHtml(entries)` — takes the entries array, returns the HTML string (table construction loop); ≤ 50 lines
    18	- New function `_bindQueueActions(container, entries)` — attaches DOM-based action buttons (kill/dismiss/view-project) and toggle listeners; ≤ 50 lines
    19	- New function `_mountLogPreviews(container, entries)` — starts log previews for expanded rows, pushes cleanup callbacks; ≤ 50 lines
    20	- Refactored `renderQueueTable` as a coordinating shell (~20 lines) that delegates to the three helpers
    21	- All existing tests pass without modification
    22	
    23	## Dependencies
    24	
    25	- WP-002
    26	
    27	## Acceptance Criteria
    28	
    29	1. `renderQueueTable` delegates to `_buildQueueHtml`, `_bindQueueActions`, and `_mountLogPreviews`.
    30	2. Each extracted helper is ≤ 50 lines.
    31	3. `renderQueueTable` itself is ≤ 30 lines (coordinating shell).
    32	4. All three helpers are module-scoped (IIFE-local), not added to any global namespace.
    33	5. The refactor is purely structural — the same statements execute in the same order; no behavioural change.
    34	6. All existing tests in `orchestrator-view.test.ts` continue to pass.
    35	7. Manual verification: orchestrator view loads, queue renders correctly, banner clears, scroll is stable, log previews work, action buttons (kill/dismiss/view-project) function correctly.

    47	Three agents independently flagged `renderQueueTable` complexity during the prior sprint. Extracting helpers keeps each function under 40 lines and makes unit-testing individual steps feasible in future sprints. The extraction stays within the same function scope (IIFE-local) to preserve locality.

    51	- **Move helpers to separate files** — rejected because the frontend is vanilla JS with no module system; file-level extraction adds complexity for no practical benefit.
